MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ethernet switch feels like a useful next step after my USB Ethernet adapter and cable purchases because it would let me connect more devices by wire.",
    "The USB extensions fit my efforts to make desk peripherals easier to reach. Short Ethernet cables also fit my cable-organizing needs, provided one foot is enough for the connections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Alexa devices and streaming sticks do not solve the computer and wired-network setup needs I am focused on. Owning a Raspberry Pi does not mean I currently want a dedicated streaming device.",
    "Another HDMI cable repeats a need I have already covered, while the 4TB SSD assumes a storage need and SATA compatibility I have not established.",
    "The Garmin memory card served a specific device; it does not make an Alexa car accessory a natural next purchase."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in smart devices, even though the practical purpose of each accessory matters more to me.",
    "Having bought a cable or memory card seems to invite more cables or storage without enough attention to whether I need another one or whether it fits my equipment."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent adapter, Ethernet cables, headphone mount, and cleaning equipment point toward improving and maintaining a practical computer workspace.",
    "Useful additions need to fit a specific gap: more wired connections or better peripheral reach. Cable length, connection type, and existing equipment can determine whether I would actually choose them."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my desk and networking needs but stretched that interest too broadly into streaming and Alexa devices."
}
